help: run the tests, then every pipeline over data/input/, the one named, or one input item of it - processing only, never acquiring

args.name: pipeline
args.help: one pipeline by name, validated against the pipelines that exist; bare, all of them

args.name: item
args.help: one input item under that pipeline's root, passed to the pipeline's run.sh as --item; bare, the whole root

args.name: --plan
args.help: print the ordered step plan; run nothing

pip install --upgrade pip: reaches PyPI on every run to check for an upgrade; skipped with a note under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND
pip install -r src/requirements.txt: reaches PyPI when the venv lacks packages; skipped under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND, so a fresh venv then fails at first import, visibly
